For certain neural architectures, stability of gradient-based methods has also been established. The work of Lei et al. ( 2022 ) proves stability-based generalization bounds for shallow ReLU networks. Complementarily, Richards and Kuzborskij ( 2021 ) analyze the dynamics of gradient descent and obtain stability and generalisation guarantees for shallow networks beyond the NTK regime. In both cases, the analysis controls how the learned parameters change under small perturbations of the training data, providing architecture-specific upper bounds on the parameter deviation and hence on Δ ​ ( ρ ) \Delta(\rho) for these models. Together, these results show that Δ ​ ( ρ ) \Delta(\rho) can be bounded in several well-understood regimes — including smooth non-convex objectives, nonsmooth convex objectives, and specific neural-network architectures for which parameter-stability analyses exist.
